questions.description: Decide whether two labelled triangles are similar and justify the comparison.

notes: The source asks whether triangles PQR and PST are similar and requires a justification. From the labelled collinear segments, PQ = PS + SQ = 18 and PR = PT + TR = 22.5; the corresponding ratios 18/12 and 22.5/15 are both 1.5, and angle P is common. This is a SAS similarity justification, with no unknown side being found. U578 therefore describes the wrong activity. U551 is a broad lower-level similarity title, and U112 is a mixed similarity/congruence title; U887 directly names geometric proofs with similarity and is the closest current catalogue match for this Higher question.
